footnote_text: (1) Received pursuant to the Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated June 24, 2026, by and among Colony Bankcorp, Inc., and First Reliance Bancshares, Inc, which closed on November 1, 2026. At the Effective Time, each share of First Reliance Bancshares, Inc common stock held by the Reporting Person was automatically converted into the right to receive .94 shares of Colony Bank Common Stock. No cash purchase price was paid for the shares received as merger consideration; on October 30, 2026, the closing price of Colony Bank common Stock was $20.34 per share. This acquisition was approved in advance by Colony Bankcorp, Inc's board of directors.
